headline: Rada Passes Sweeping Financial Law: What Will Change for Ukrainians and Banks
summary: The Verkhovna Rada passed a law changing rules for winding down banks and protecting savings. Guaranteed deposits will be repaid automatically, and financial institutions face higher reliability requirements.
why: The Verkhovna Rada is Ukraine's parliament, and bank resolution and deposit insurance rules shape depositor confidence and the stability of the banking sector.
